requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing
requirements.note: Cover letter explicitly states 'I have not done phased-array algorithm design' -- the topic is addressed but as an explicit disclaimer of the experience rather than a claim or evidence of it; recorded as not_stated since the fixed status vocabulary has no category for an explicit negative statement.

lines.quote: Carried out a full characterisation of Hallaharju Space Systems' S-band receive-chain components: S-parameter sweeps, noise-figure measurements, and gain-flatness verification across temperature using Rohde & Schwarz ZVA and FSW equipment.
MSc Electrical Engineering, Kallavesi University of Technology, 2019
I also have a working familiarity with Kalman filtering and estimation theory, which I understand has relevance to the tracking and state-estimation aspects of remote-sensing signal processing.
Hungarian citizen with full EU work authorisation; resident in Finland since 2019.
English is the company's working language for all documentation and team communication.

requirements.name: Onsite in Oulu / relocation
requirements.note: Cover letter discusses the Oulu RF and photonics engineering cluster as an ecosystem the candidate has been watching for several years, but does not state the candidate's own current location or willingness to relocate/work onsite there; CV gives no location for the current role.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ that runs on real hardware under real timing constraints, if any?
Can you describe any Python development work you have done that was tested, maintained, and used by others in a production setting, if any?
